items.description: Do all five channel sources assert VALID independently of READY and hold the complete payload stable until an accepting edge?
Does the AXI4 write checker allow W before AW while requiring accepted AW and accepted final W before BVALID?
Are AWLEN/ARLEN beat counts, WLAST/RLAST, WSTRB, alignment, WRAP progression, and the full 4 KB span checked on accepted transfers?
Does every BID/RID select an outstanding transaction of the correct channel type and retire the correct per-ID queue entry?
Have same-ID issue order, different-ID response reordering, repeated-ID outstanding traffic, and cross-target response routing all been demonstrated?
Does the independent reference model compare address, attributes, byte enables, expected data, response, and target context rather than checking ID alone?
Have outstanding read and write capacities been reached at full/empty boundaries with independent AW, W, B, AR, and R backpressure?
Are OKAY, EXOKAY, SLVERR, and DECERR checked in their valid contexts, with all declared data transfers completed after an error?
Do checker configuration and stimulus match the implemented AXI revision, ID widths, optional USER/REGION fields, and exclusive-access capability?
Are protocol safety requirements separated from documented fairness, QoS, timeout, latency, and throughput contracts?
Has every critical coverage bin been tied to a passing assertion or scoreboard result, with legal holes and exclusions reviewed individually?
Do formal proofs and signoff reports record reset behavior, environment assumptions, proof bounds, vacuity checks, waivers, and reproducible failure traces?
